# `ew query`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from bin/ew/api/cli.json and bin/ew/schemas/. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

1 subcommand path(s). The synopsis lists the flags; `ew help` prints the positional arguments too.

## `ew query`

```text
ew query [--project <project>] [--explain] [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--explain` | no | no |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | answered |
| 2 | usage, an unknown query, open errors, a key that names no record or one of another kind |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.query-result/1`, schema [`ew.query-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.query-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.query-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `explain` | [`QueryExplain`](#queryexplain) or `null` | no |  | The explanation (`--explain`); `null` without it. |
| `key` | string | yes |  | The key as given (`tag:-101F1`, `-`). |
| `output` | any JSON value | yes |  | The query's output object; its schema is the query's `output` in `ew queries --json`. |
| `query` | string | yes |  | The query's name (`device_tag`). |
| `rev` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) | yes |  | The session's revision the answer was computed at. |

### QueryExplain

The explanation of a query's value (`ew query --explain`, D12): the memo's policy and state, its dependencies and
the property row's provenance. No wall-clock time: revisions are the session's.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `changed_at` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) or `null` | no |  | The revision at which its value last changed; `null` without a memo. |
| `depends_on` | array of string | yes |  | The memo's dependencies in read order, in words (at most 64, then `…`): memos by family and described key, inputs by record kind and tag, folio or ID, each with the revision observed. |
| `family` | string | yes |  | The memo family explained: the query's own, or the outermost memoised family of a composed query. |
| `hit` | boolean or `null` | no |  | Whether the memo held the value, verified, before the query ran; `null` for a family without a memo. |
| `policy` | string | yes |  | The policy line (`Memo · device_tag · verified at rev 1 (miss) · changed at rev 1`). |
| `provenance` | string or `null` | no |  | The `via` of the property-grid row the query backs (`device_tag`, `cell_of`); `null` otherwise. |
| `verified_at` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) or `null` | no |  | The revision at which the memo was last confirmed valid; `null` without a memo. |
